headline: Woman's dismembered body found in suitcase under Gazipur culvert
summary: Police recovered the decomposed remains of an unidentified woman, aged 30-35, from a suitcase and sacks near the Dhaka-Mymensingh highway.
details: Police recovered the decomposed remains of an unidentified woman from a blue suitcase found under a culvert in the Bhabanipur area of Joydebpur, Gazipur.
Local residents noticed the suitcase near Fakiira Garments beside the Dhaka-Mymensingh highway on Friday afternoon and alerted the authorities.
Upon opening the suitcase, police found fragmented parts of the body. Further searches in the surrounding area led to the recovery of other body parts packed in sacks.
The remains have been sent to Gazipur Shaheed Tajuddin Ahmad Medical College morgue for a post-mortem examination to determine the cause of death.
Joydebpur Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Al Mamun stated that the woman appeared to be between 30 and 35 years old, though her identity remains unknown due to the state of decomposition.
Police suspect the woman was murdered elsewhere, and her body was subsequently dismembered and dumped in the suitcase and sacks at the location.
caption:
A woman's dismembered and decomposed body was found packed in a suitcase and sacks under a culvert in Gazipur.

Police recovered the decomposed remains of an unidentified woman from a blue suitcase found under a culvert in the Bhabanipur area of Joydebpur, Gazipur.

Local residents noticed the suitcase near Fakiira Garments beside the Dhaka-Mymensingh highway on Friday afternoon and alerted the authorities.

Upon opening the suitcase, police found fragmented parts of the body. Further searches in the surrounding area led to the recovery of other body parts packed in sacks.

The remains have been sent to Gazipur Shaheed Tajuddin Ahmad Medical College morgue for a post-mortem examination to determine the cause of death.

Joydebpur Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Al Mamun stated that the woman appeared to be between 30 and 35 years old, though her identity remains unknown due to the state of decomposition.

Police suspect the woman was murdered elsewhere, and her body was subsequently dismembered and dumped in the suitcase and sacks at the location.

Source: Prothom Alo, Dhaka Tribune

headline: Former Samakal bureau chief journalist found dead in Barisal office
summary: Pulak Chatterjee was found hanging in the regional office of the daily Samakal. Police recovered five suicide notes from the scene.
details: Pulak Chatterjee, the former Barisal bureau chief of the daily Samakal, was found dead on Friday evening in the newspaper's regional office on Parara Road.
// Police recovered the body in a hanging position and found five separate suicide notes at the scene. One note stated that no one was responsible for his death.
caption:
A veteran journalist and former bureau chief found dead in his former office. Police recovered five suicide notes from the scene.

Pulak Chatterjee, the former Barisal bureau chief of the daily Samakal, was found dead on Friday evening in the newspaper's regional office on Parara Road.

// Police recovered the body in a hanging position and found five separate suicide notes at the scene. One note stated that no one was responsible for his death.
